# Native product export fixtures

Two actual local ForgeFlow MCP/approval/export runs on public CATL 2025 and Apple FY2025 reports, captured 2026-11-24. The accounts are scripted integration-author/integration-reviewer identities, not actual user adoption. No credentials or private database is included. Source document hashes and row contents are preserved for independent evaluation.

`wrong_receipt.json` is explicitly a synthetic mutation of the real Apple export with an invalid delivery receipt. It is not another model or tool run. No fixture is a held-out accuracy benchmark.
